messages:
Marina: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. Dropping the reliability follow-ups here — RCA links + concrete action items.
Marina: RCA: https://redwood-internal.company/rca/INC-2025-042 — short summary: KV cache eviction thundering during cluster autoscale caused tail latency spikes and intermittent 502s.
Marina: Action items (owners & ETA):
• Ravi — add jitter + throttle to cache-eviction path to spread work (PR by 2025-03-28)
• Jules — propose autoscaler warm-pool heuristics to reduce cold-scale events (proposal by 2025-04-01)
• Sam — implement an end-to-end synthetic that exercises KV dependency to catch regressions (monitoring + alert by 2025-03-31)
• Leah — prepare customer comms draft & postmortem blurb for Hosted/Dedicated customers (by 2025-03-29)
Marina: Drop-in runbook and full postmortem below. Please don't edit the RCA until owners have reviewed.
Marina: Runbook: https://redwood-internal.company/runbooks/kv-eviction
Marina: Full postmortem doc: https://confluence.redwood.company/x/rca-INC-2025-042
Jules: Quick question — what are the rollout guardrails for the autoscaler change? @Marina
Marina: Jules — plan is a 10% canary (CPU footprint), 48h observation window, and auto-rollback if error rate increases >1% or tail latency regresses beyond SLO.
Jules: Sounds reasonable. Timeline? Do we run E2E before canary?
Marina: Yes — E2E synthetic will run in staging Wed, canary Thurs-Fri if no issues.
Sam: Who owns the CI job that flaked during the incident? I saw a lot of noise from integration tests.
Ravi: That was my test suite — investigating flaky KV restore. I'll open a fix PR and link it here :white_check_mark:
Ravi: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/881
Leah: For customer comms — do we need legal review? Some Dedicated customers require more formal language.
Marina: Leah — legal is looped and ok with the draft. We escalate to legal only if we identify an SLA breach. Draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/comm-draft
Eli: Can we add an alert that correlates eviction spikes with autoscaler scale events? That would make oncall triage way faster.
Sam: +1
Marina: Good call. Sam & Ravi — add a correlation alert that pages on sustained 5m correlation between eviction rate and scale events. Low-sev page. ETA 2025-03-30.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2025-042 status updated: Postmortem published. https://incident.redwood.company/INC-2025-042
Marina: I'll do a short follow-up in next week's eng sync to track progress against these action items. Can owners drop one-line updates here by EOD Friday?
Jules: Will do — updating my card now.
Ravi: Will post PR link + test results once merged.
Leah: I will publish the customer blurb after a quick legal check.
Eli: Adding the alert runbook snippet to the runbook page.
Sam: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround on this. :pray:
Marina: Thanks — appreciate everyone's focus. I'll close this loop after the sync.
